newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light trade in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds remained calm despite a further rise in Chicago soymeal futures this afternoon, market sources said.

"Seller prices for South American soymeal pellets rose as much as $15 after Friday's Chicago limit-up close. This rise coupled to a stronger dollar and continued logistical problems due to frozen inland waterways discouraged many buyers from entering the market. Even calls for a further rise in Chicago soycomplex futures this afternoon failed to spark activity," one broker said.
